title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
Join our finance analytics team to measure how small businesses use Nimbus.

You will:
- Write SQL to answer product questions
- Build and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Looker
- Present findings in our weekly metrics review

Requirements:
- Solid SQL
- Experience with a BI tool such as Power BI or Looker
- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills
- Fluent written English
- Nice to have: Python for analysis

Location: fully remote. We hire anywhere in Europe, including countries outside the EU, as long as you work within CET plus or minus two hours.

How to apply: apply through our careers portal and answer two short questions.

questions: Why do you want to work at Nimbus Ledger?
Describe a time you automated or sped up a report.
